verdict.rationale: Productboard ships an official MCP server that lets AI agents add features, reschedule initiatives, update prioritization fields, and pull specifications using natural-language-driven agent calls, which directly enables natural-language operation of the product (productboard-docs-10 to -13, probe-3). However, this is all first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on validation of how robust or comprehensive the natural-language command coverage actually is. Missing for 10: independent or community verification of MCP server reliability, and evidence of broader NL command coverage beyond the specific examples (features, initiatives, prioritization fields).
